subject.title: fix(agents): use currentAttemptAssistant for incomplete-turn classification

question: Is source-level terminal proof plus regression coverage sufficient for this classifier-only message-delivery fix, or should this PR wait for a live configured channel run?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source-backed, but it changes terminal message-delivery classification and the contributor did not reproduce the full live WhatsApp/OpenRouter transport scenario from the linked issue.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
